body.message: Packet inspection requires Linux with util-linux prlimit and TShark 4.x (on PATH or through absolute REA_TSHARK_COMMAND) so expanded captures are processed under an enforced address-space limit. On Linux, supply TShark 4.x on PATH or through absolute REA_TSHARK_COMMAND, and util-linux prlimit through REA_TSHARK_PRLIMIT_COMMAND (default /usr/bin/prlimit).
